bsb.24:7: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row, so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
bsb.24:8: Every Sabbath day the bread is to be set out before the LORD on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant.
bsb.24:9: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place; for it is to him a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD—his portion forever.”
bsb.24:10: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.
bsb.24:11: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse. So they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)
bsb.24:12: They placed him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them.
bsb.24:13: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.24:14: “Take the blasphemer outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have the whole assembly stone him.
bsb.24:15: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘If anyone curses his God, he shall bear the consequences of his sin.
bsb.24:16: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death; the whole assembly must surely stone him, whether he is a foreign resident or native; if he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death.
bsb.24:17: And if a man takes the life of anyone else, he must surely be put to death.
bsb.24:18: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution—life for life.
bsb.24:19: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:
bsb.24:20: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. Just as he injured the other person, the same must be inflicted on him.
bsb.24:21: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.
bsb.24:22: You are to have the same standard of law for the foreign resident and the native; for I am the LORD your God.’”
bsb.24:23: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.25:1: Then the LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
bsb.25:2: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you, the land itself must observe a Sabbath to the LORD.
bsb.25:3: For six years you may sow your field and prune your vineyard and gather its crops.
bsb.25:4: But in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of complete rest for the land—a Sabbath to the LORD. You are not to sow your field or prune your vineyard.
bsb.25:5: You are not to reap the aftergrowth of your harvest or gather the grapes of your untended vines. The land must have a year of complete rest.
bsb.25:6: Whatever the land yields during the Sabbath year shall be food for you—for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, the hired hand or foreigner who stays with you,
bsb.25:7: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food.
bsb.25:8: And you shall count off seven Sabbaths of years—seven times seven years—so that the seven Sabbaths of years amount to forty-nine years.
bsb.25:9: Then you are to sound the horn far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement. You shall sound it throughout your land.
bsb.25:10: So you are to consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.
bsb.25:11: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.
bsb.25:12: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You may eat only the crops taken directly from the field.
bsb.25:13: In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.
bsb.25:14: If you make a sale to your neighbor or a purchase from him, you must not take advantage of each other.
bsb.25:15: You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.
bsb.25:16: You shall increase the price in proportion to a greater number of years, or decrease it in proportion to a lesser number of years; for he is selling you a given number of harvests.
bsb.25:17: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
bsb.25:18: You are to keep My statutes and carefully observe My judgments, so that you may dwell securely in the land.
bsb.25:19: Then the land will yield its fruit, so that you can eat your fill and dwell in safety in the land.
bsb.25:20: Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’
bsb.25:21: But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.
bsb.25:22: While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.
bsb.25:23: The land must not be sold permanently, because it is Mine, and you are but foreigners and residents with Me.
bsb.25:24: Thus for every piece of property you possess, you must provide for the redemption of the land.
bsb.25:25: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his property, his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold.
bsb.25:26: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,
bsb.25:27: he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.
bsb.25:28: But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.
bsb.25:29: If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains his right of redemption until a full year after its sale; during that year it may be redeemed.
bsb.25:30: If it is not redeemed by the end of a full year, then the house in the walled city is permanently transferred to its buyer and his descendants. It is not to be released in the Jubilee.
bsb.25:31: But houses in villages with no walls around them are to be considered as open fields. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
bsb.25:32: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.
bsb.25:33: So whatever belongs to the Levites may be redeemed—a house sold in a city they possess—and must be released in the Jubilee, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the Israelites.
bsb.25:34: But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.
bsb.25:35: Now if your countryman becomes destitute and cannot support himself among you, then you are to help him as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.
bsb.25:36: Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.
bsb.25:37: You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.
bsb.25:38: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
bsb.25:39: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.
bsb.25:40: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
bsb.25:41: Then he and his children are to be released, and he may return to his clan and to the property of his fathers.
bsb.25:42: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
bsb.25:43: You are not to rule over them harshly, but you shall fear your God.
bsb.25:44: Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.
bsb.25:45: You may also purchase them from the foreigners residing among you or their clans living among you who are born in your land. These may become your property.
bsb.25:46: You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.
bsb.25:47: If a foreigner residing among you prospers, but your countryman dwelling near him becomes destitute and sells himself to the foreigner or to a member of his clan,
bsb.25:48: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him:
bsb.25:49: either his uncle or cousin or any close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.
bsb.25:50: He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale will be determined by the number of years, based on the daily wages of a hired hand.
bsb.25:51: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.
bsb.25:52: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to calculate and pay his redemption according to his remaining years.
bsb.25:53: He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.
bsb.25:54: Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children shall be released in the Year of Jubilee.
bsb.25:55: For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
bsb.26:1: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.
bsb.26:2: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
bsb.26:3: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,
bsb.26:4: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
bsb.26:5: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.
bsb.26:6: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
bsb.26:7: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.
bsb.26:8: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
bsb.26:9: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.
bsb.26:10: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
bsb.26:11: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.
bsb.26:12: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.
bsb.26:13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.
bsb.26:14: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,
bsb.26:15: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,
bsb.26:16: then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
bsb.26:17: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
bsb.26:18: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
bsb.26:19: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,
bsb.26:20: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
bsb.26:21: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.
bsb.26:22: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.
bsb.26:23: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
bsb.26:24: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
bsb.26:25: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
bsb.26:26: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.
bsb.26:27: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
bsb.26:28: then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.
bsb.26:29: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
bsb.26:30: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.
bsb.26:31: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.
bsb.26:32: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.
bsb.26:33: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.
bsb.26:34: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
bsb.26:35: As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.
bsb.26:36: As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.
bsb.26:37: They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
bsb.26:38: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.
bsb.26:39: Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers.
bsb.26:40: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me—
bsb.26:41: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,
bsb.26:42: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
bsb.26:43: For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.
bsb.26:44: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
bsb.26:45: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.”
bsb.26:46: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.
bsb.27:1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.27:2: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘When someone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the value of persons,
bsb.27:3: if the valuation concerns a male from twenty to sixty years of age, then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel.
bsb.27:4: Or if it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
bsb.27:5: And if the person is from five to twenty years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
bsb.27:6: Now if the person is from one month to five years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be five shekels of silver, and for the female three shekels of silver.
bsb.27:7: And if the person is sixty years of age or older, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels for the male and ten shekels for the female.
bsb.27:8: But if the one making the vow is too poor to pay the valuation, he is to present the person before the priest, who shall set the value according to what the one making the vow can afford.
bsb.27:9: If he vows an animal that may be brought as an offering to the LORD, any such animal given to the LORD shall be holy.
bsb.27:10: He must not replace it or exchange it, either good for bad or bad for good. But if he does substitute one animal for another, both that animal and its substitute will be holy.
bsb.27:11: But if the vow involves any of the unclean animals that may not be brought as an offering to the LORD, the animal must be presented before the priest.
bsb.27:12: The priest shall set its value, whether high or low; as the priest values it, the price will be set.
bsb.27:13: If, however, the owner decides to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.
bsb.27:14: Now if a man consecrates his house as holy to the LORD, then the priest shall value it either as good or bad. The price will stand just as the priest values it.
bsb.27:15: But if he who consecrated his house redeems it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it will belong to him.
bsb.27:16: If a man consecrates to the LORD a parcel of his land, then your valuation shall be proportional to the seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed.
bsb.27:17: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the price will stand according to your valuation.
bsb.27:18: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest is to calculate the price in proportion to the years left until the next Year of Jubilee, so that your valuation will be reduced.
bsb.27:19: And if the one who consecrated the field decides to redeem it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it shall belong to him.
bsb.27:20: If, however, he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold it to another man, it may no longer be redeemed.
bsb.27:21: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it becomes the property of the priests.
bsb.27:22: Now if a man consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased, which is not a part of his own property,
bsb.27:23: then the priest shall calculate for him the value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man shall pay the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD.
bsb.27:24: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought—the original owner of the land.
bsb.27:25: Every valuation will be according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.
bsb.27:26: But no one may consecrate a firstborn of the livestock, because a firstborn belongs to the LORD. Whether it is an ox or a sheep, it is the LORD’s.
bsb.27:27: But if it is among the unclean animals, then he may redeem it according to your valuation and add a fifth of its value. If it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
bsb.27:28: Nothing that a man sets apart to the LORD from all he owns—whether a man, an animal, or his inherited land—can be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the LORD.
bsb.27:29: No person set apart for destruction may be ransomed; he must surely be put to death.
bsb.27:30: Thus any tithe from the land, whether from the seed of the land or the fruit of the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD.
bsb.27:31: If a man wishes to redeem part of his tithe, he must add a fifth to its value.
bsb.27:32: Every tenth animal from the herd or flock that passes under the shepherd’s rod will be holy to the LORD.
bsb.27:33: He must not inspect whether it is good or bad, and he shall not make any substitution. But if he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute shall become holy; they cannot be redeemed.’”
bsb.27:34: These are the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Sinai.

asv.1:1: And Jehovah called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tent of meeting, saying,
asv.1:2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man of you offereth an oblation unto Jehovah, ye shall offer your oblation of the cattle, even of the herd and of the flock.
asv.1:3: If his oblation be a burnt-offering of the herd, he shall offer it a male without blemish: he shall offer it at the door of the tent of meeting, that he may be accepted before Jehovah.
asv.1:4: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burnt-offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
asv.1:5: And he shall kill the bullock before Jehovah: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is at the door of the tent of meeting.
asv.1:6: And he shall flay the burnt-offering, and cut it into its pieces.
asv.1:7: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay wood in order upon the fire;
asv.1:8: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
asv.1:9: but its inwards and its legs shall he wash with water. And the priest shall burn the whole on the altar, for a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
asv.1:10: And if his oblation be of the flock, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt-offering; he shall offer it a male without blemish.
asv.1:11: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before Jehovah: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood upon the altar round about.
asv.1:12: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
asv.1:13: but the inwards and the legs shall he wash with water. And the priest shall offer the whole, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
asv.1:14: And if his oblation to Jehovah be a burnt-offering of birds, then he shall offer his oblation of turtle-doves, or of young pigeons.
asv.1:15: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
asv.1:16: and he shall take away its crop with the filth thereof, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes:
asv.1:17: and he shall rend it by the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder. And the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
asv.2:1: And when any one offereth an oblation of a meal-offering unto Jehovah, his oblation shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
asv.2:2: and he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests; and he shall take thereout his handful of the fine flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof. And the priest shall burn it as the memorial thereof upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah:
asv.2:3: and that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire.
asv.2:4: And when thou offerest an oblation of a meal-offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
asv.2:5: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the baking-pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
asv.2:6: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meal-offering.
asv.2:7: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the frying-pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
asv.2:8: And thou shalt bring the meal-offering that is made of these things unto Jehovah: and it shall be presented unto the priest, and he shall bring it unto the altar.
asv.2:9: And the priest shall take up from the meal-offering the memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
asv.2:10: And that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire.
asv.2:11: No meal-offering, which ye shall offer unto Jehovah, shall be made with leaven; for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
asv.2:12: As an oblation of first- fruits ye shall offer them unto Jehovah: but they shall not come up for a sweet savor on the altar.
asv.2:13: And every oblation of thy meal-offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meal-offering: with all thine oblations thou shalt offer salt.
asv.2:14: And if thou offer a meal-offering of first-fruits unto Jehovah, thou shalt offer for the meal-offering of thy first-fruits grain in the ear parched with fire, bruised grain of the fresh ear.
asv.2:15: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meal-offering.
asv.2:16: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the bruised grain thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
asv.3:1: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace-offerings; if he offer of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Jehovah.
asv.3:2: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his oblation, and kill it at the door of the tent of meeting: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
asv.3:3: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
asv.3:4: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.
asv.3:5: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt-offering, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
asv.3:6: And if his oblation for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
asv.3:7: If he offer a lamb for his oblation, then shall he offer it before Jehovah;
asv.3:8: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of his oblation, and kill it before the tent of meeting: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
asv.3:9: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat thereof, the fat tail entire, he shall take away hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
asv.3:10: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.
asv.3:11: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
asv.3:12: And if his oblation be a goat, then he shall offer it before Jehovah:
asv.3:13: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
asv.3:14: And he shall offer thereof his oblation, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
asv.3:15: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.
asv.3:16: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a sweet savor; all the fat is Jehovah’s.
asv.3:17: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that ye shall eat neither fat nor blood.
asv.4:1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.4:2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any one shall sin unwittingly, in any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and shall do any one of them:
asv.4:3: if the anointed priest shall sin so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto Jehovah for a sin-offering.
asv.4:4: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tent of meeting before Jehovah; and he shall lay his hand upon the head of the bullock, and kill the bullock before Jehovah.
asv.4:5: And the anointed priest shall take of the blood of the bullock, and bring it to the tent of meeting:
asv.4:6: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before Jehovah, before the veil of the sanctuary.
asv.4:7: And the priest shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Jehovah, which is in the tent of meeting; and all the blood of the bullock shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the door of the tent of meeting.
asv.4:8: And all the fat of the bullock of the sin-offering he shall take off from it; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
asv.4:9: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away,
asv.4:10: as it is taken off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace-offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of burnt-offering.
asv.4:11: And the skin of the bullock, and all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, and its inwards, and its dung,
asv.4:12: even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall it be burnt.
asv.4:13: And if the whole congregation of Israel err, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and are guilty;
asv.4:14: when the sin wherein they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bullock for a sin-offering, and bring it before the tent of meeting.
asv.4:15: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before Jehovah; and the bullock shall be killed before Jehovah.
asv.4:16: And the anointed priest shall bring of the blood of the bullock to the tent of meeting:
asv.4:17: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Jehovah, before the veil.
asv.4:18: And he shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before Jehovah, that is in the tent of meeting; and all the blood shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the door of the tent of meeting.
asv.4:19: And all the fat thereof shall he take off from it, and burn it upon the altar.
asv.4:20: Thus shall he do with the bullock; as he did with the bullock of the sin-offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
asv.4:21: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bullock: it is the sin-offering for the assembly.
asv.4:22: When a ruler sinneth, and doeth unwittingly any one of all the things which Jehovah his God hath commanded not to be done, and is guilty;
asv.4:23: if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, be made known to him, he shall bring for his oblation a goat, a male without blemish.
asv.4:24: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt-offering before Jehovah: it is a sin-offering.
asv.4:25: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering; and the blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering.
asv.4:26: And all the fat thereof shall he burn upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin, and he shall be forgiven.
asv.4:27: And if any one of the common people sin unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and be guilty;
asv.4:28: if his sin, which he hath sinned, be made known to him, then he shall bring for his oblation a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
asv.4:29: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill the sin-offering in the place of burnt-offering.
asv.4:30: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering; and all the blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar.
asv.4:31: And all the fat thereof shall he take away, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savor unto Jehovah; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.
asv.4:32: And if he bring a lamb as his oblation for a sin-offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
asv.4:33: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill it for a sin-offering in the place where they kill the burnt-offering.
asv.4:34: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering; and all the blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar.
asv.4:35: And all the fat thereof shall he take away, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall burn them on the altar, upon the offerings of Jehovah made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
asv.5:1: And if any one sin, in that he heareth the voice of adjuration, he being a witness, whether he hath seen or known, if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
asv.5:2: Or if any one touch any unclean thing, whether it be the carcass of an unclean beast, or the carcass of unclean cattle, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it be hidden from him, and he be unclean, then he shall be guilty.
asv.5:3: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever his uncleanness be wherewith he is unclean, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
asv.5:4: Or if any one swear rashly with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall utter rashly with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these things.
asv.5:5: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that wherein he hath sinned:
asv.5:6: and he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin.
asv.5:7: And if his means suffice not for a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass-offering for that wherein he hath sinned, two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, unto Jehovah; one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering.
asv.5:8: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin-offering first, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
asv.5:9: and he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin-offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar: it is a sin-offering.
asv.5:10: And he shall offer the second for a burnt-offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin which he hath sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
asv.5:11: But if his means suffice not for two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his oblation for that wherein he hath sinned, the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin-offering: he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon; for it is a sin-offering.
asv.5:12: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, upon the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: it is a sin-offering.
asv.5:13: And the priest shall make atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in any of these things, and he shall be forgiven: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as the meal-offering.
asv.5:14: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.5:15: If any one commit a trespass, and sin unwittingly, in the holy things of Jehovah; then he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass-offering:
asv.5:16: and he shall make restitution for that which he hath done amiss in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering, and he shall be forgiven.
asv.5:17: And if any one sin, and do any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done; though he knew it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
asv.5:18: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation, for a trespass-offering, unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing wherein he erred unwittingly and knew it not, and he shall be forgiven.
asv.5:19: It is a trespass-offering: he is certainly guilty before Jehovah.
asv.6:1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.6:2: If any one sin, and commit a trespass against Jehovah, and deal falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or have oppressed his neighbor,
asv.6:3: or have found that which was lost, and deal falsely therein, and swear to a lie; in any of all these things that a man doeth, sinning therein;
asv.6:4: then it shall be, if he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he hath gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,
asv.6:5: or any thing about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in full, and shall add the fifth part more thereto: unto him to whom it appertaineth shall he give it, in the day of his being found guilty.
asv.6:6: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation, for a trespass-offering, unto the priest:
asv.6:7: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah; and he shall be forgiven concerning whatsoever he doeth so as to be guilty thereby.
asv.6:8: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.6:9: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt-offering: the burnt-offering shall be on the hearth upon the altar all night unto the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning thereon.
asv.6:10: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh; and he shall take up the ashes whereto the fire hath consumed the burnt-offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
asv.6:11: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
asv.6:12: And the fire upon the altar shall be kept burning thereon, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning: and he shall lay the burnt-offering in order upon it, and shall burn thereon the fat of the peace-offerings.
asv.6:13: Fire shall be kept burning upon the altar continually; it shall not go out.
asv.6:14: And this is the law of the meal-offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Jehovah, before the altar.
asv.6:15: And he shall take up therefrom his handful, of the fine flour of the meal-offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meal-offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savor, as the memorial thereof, unto Jehovah.
asv.6:16: And that which is left thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place; in the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.
asv.6:17: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as the sin-offering, and as the trespass-offering.
asv.6:18: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as his portion for ever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: whosoever toucheth them shall be holy.
asv.6:19: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.6:20: This is the oblation of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto Jehovah in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half thereof in the evening.
asv.6:21: On a baking-pan it shall be made with oil; when it is soaked, thou shalt bring it in: in baken pieces shalt thou offer the meal-offering for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
asv.6:22: And the anointed priest that shall be in his stead from among his sons shall offer it: by a statute for ever it shall be wholly burnt unto Jehovah.
asv.6:23: And every meal-offering of the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
asv.6:24: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.6:25: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering: in the place where the burnt-offering is killed shall the sin-offering be killed before Jehovah: it is most holy.
asv.6:26: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.
asv.6:27: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy; and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in a holy place.
asv.6:28: But the earthen vessel wherein it is boiled shall be broken; and if it be boiled in a brazen vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.
asv.6:29: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
asv.6:30: And no sin-offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt with fire.
asv.7:1: And this is the law of the trespass-offering: it is most holy.
asv.7:2: In the place where they kill the burnt-offering shall they kill the trespass-offering; and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle upon the altar round about.
asv.7:3: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof: the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
asv.7:4: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;
asv.7:5: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a trespass-offering.
asv.7:6: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in a holy place: it is most holy.
asv.7:7: As is the sin-offering, so is the trespass-offering; there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith, he shall have it.
asv.7:8: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt-offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath offered.
asv.7:9: And every meal-offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the frying-pan, and on the baking-pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
asv.7:10: And every meal-offering, mingled with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as well as another.
asv.7:11: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which one shall offer unto Jehovah.
asv.7:12: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour soaked.
asv.7:13: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his oblation with the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving.
asv.7:14: And of it he shall offer one out of each oblation for a heave-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace-offerings.
asv.7:15: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his oblation; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
asv.7:16: But if the sacrifice of his oblation be a vow, or a freewill-offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offereth his sacrifice; and on the morrow that which remaineth of it shall be eaten:
asv.7:17: but that which remaineth of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
asv.7:18: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings be eaten on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
asv.7:19: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire. And as for the flesh, every one that is clean shall eat thereof:
asv.7:20: but the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, that pertain unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
asv.7:21: And when any one shall touch any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean beast, or any unclean abomination, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which pertain unto Jehovah, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
asv.7:22: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.7:23: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no fat, of ox, or sheep, or goat.
asv.7:24: And the fat of that which dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of beasts, may be used for any other service; but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
asv.7:25: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
asv.7:26: And ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of bird or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
asv.7:27: Whosoever it be that eateth any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
asv.7:28: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.7:29: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace-offerings unto Jehovah shall bring his oblation unto Jehovah out of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings:
asv.7:30: his own hands shall bring the offerings of Jehovah made by fire; the fat with the breast shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
asv.7:31: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar; but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
asv.7:32: And the right thigh shall ye give unto the priest for a heave-offering out of the sacrifices of your peace-offerings.
asv.7:33: He among the sons of Aaron that offereth the blood of the peace-offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
asv.7:34: For the wave-breast and the heave-thigh have I taken of the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons as their portion for ever from the children of Israel.
asv.7:35: This is the anointing-portion of Aaron, and the anointing-portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto Jehovah in the priest’s office;
asv.7:36: which Jehovah commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion for ever throughout their generations.
asv.7:37: This is the law of the burnt-offering, of the meal-offering, and of the sin-offering, and of the trespass-offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace-offerings;
asv.7:38: which Jehovah commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai.
asv.8:1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.8:2: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bullock of the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
asv.8:3: and assemble thou all the congregation at the door of the tent of meeting.
asv.8:4: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the tent of meeting.
asv.8:5: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded to be done.
asv.8:6: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
asv.8:7: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
asv.8:8: And he placed the breastplate upon him: and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.
asv.8:9: And he set the mitre upon his head; and upon the mitre, in front, did he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
asv.8:10: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
asv.8:11: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the laver and its base, to sanctify them.
asv.8:12: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
asv.8:13: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with coats, and girded them with girdles, and bound head-tires upon them; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
asv.8:14: And he brought the bullock of the sin-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock of the sin-offering.
asv.8:15: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
asv.8:16: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it upon the altar.
asv.8:17: But the bullock, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
asv.8:18: And he presented the ram of the burnt-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
asv.8:19: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
asv.8:20: And he cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
asv.8:21: And he washed the inwards and the legs with water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt-offering for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
asv.8:22: And he presented the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
asv.8:23: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood thereof, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
asv.8:24: And he brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
asv.8:25: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh:
asv.8:26: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Jehovah, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and upon the right thigh:
asv.8:27: and he put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and waved them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
asv.8:28: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt-offering: they were a consecration for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
asv.8:29: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: it was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
asv.8:30: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
asv.8:31: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tent of meeting: and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
asv.8:32: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
asv.8:33: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration be fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
asv.8:34: As hath been done this day, so Jehovah hath commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
asv.8:35: And at the door of the tent of meeting shall ye abide day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Jehovah, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
asv.8:36: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which Jehovah commanded by Moses.
asv.9:1: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
asv.9:2: and he said unto Aaron, Take thee a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering, without blemish, and offer them before Jehovah.
asv.9:3: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a he-goat for a sin-offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt-offering;
asv.9:4: and an ox and a ram for peace-offerings, to sacrifice before Jehovah; and a meal-offering mingled with oil: for to-day Jehovah appeareth unto you.
asv.9:5: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tent of meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Jehovah.
asv.9:6: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded that ye should do: and the glory of Jehovah shall appear unto you.
asv.9:7: And Moses said unto Aaron, Draw near unto the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for the people; and offer the oblation of the people, and make atonement for them; as Jehovah commanded.
asv.9:8: So Aaron drew near unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin-offering, which was for himself.
asv.9:9: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood unto him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:
asv.9:10: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul from the liver of the sin-offering, he burnt upon the altar; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
asv.9:11: And the flesh and the skin he burnt with fire without the camp.
asv.9:12: And he slew the burnt-offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered unto him the blood, and he sprinkled it upon the altar round about.
asv.9:13: And they delivered the burnt-offering unto him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
asv.9:14: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt-offering on the altar.
asv.9:15: And he presented the people’s oblation, and took the goat of the sin-offering which was for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
asv.9:16: And he presented the burnt-offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
asv.9:17: And he presented the meal-offering, and filled his hand therefrom, and burnt it upon the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.
asv.9:18: He slew also the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
asv.9:19: and the fat of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul of the liver:
asv.9:20: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
asv.9:21: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah; as Moses commanded.
asv.9:22: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings.
asv.9:23: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the people.
asv.9:24: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and consumed upon the altar the burnt-offering and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
asv.10:1: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took each of them his censer, and put fire therein, and laid incense thereon, and offered strange fire before Jehovah, which he had not commanded them.
asv.10:2: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and devoured them, and they died before Jehovah.
asv.10:3: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that Jehovah spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
asv.10:4: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Draw near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
asv.10:5: So they drew near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.
asv.10:6: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Let not the hair of your heads go loose, neither rend your clothes; that ye die not, and that he be not wroth with all the congregation: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Jehovah hath kindled.
asv.10:7: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting, lest ye die; for the anointing oil of Jehovah is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
asv.10:8: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, saying,
asv.10:9: Drink no wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tent of meeting, that ye die not: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
asv.10:10: and that ye may make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;
asv.10:11: and that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Jehovah hath spoken unto them by Moses.
asv.10:12: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meal-offering that remaineth of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar; for it is most holy;
asv.10:13: and ye shall eat it in a holy place, because it is thy portion, and thy sons’ portion, of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: for so I am commanded.
asv.10:14: And the wave-breast and the heave-thigh shall ye eat in a clean place, thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they are given as thy portion, and thy sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace-offerings of the children of Israel.
asv.10:15: The heave-thigh and the wave-breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, as a portion for ever; as Jehovah hath commanded.
asv.10:16: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,
asv.10:17: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin-offering in the place of the sanctuary, seeing it is most holy, and he hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Jehovah?
asv.10:18: Behold, the blood of it was not brought into the sanctuary within: ye should certainly have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.
asv.10:19: And Aaron spake unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin-offering and their burnt-offering before Jehovah; and there have befallen me such things as these: and if I had eaten the sin-offering to-day, would it have been well-pleasing in the sight of Jehovah?
asv.10:20: And when Moses heard that, it was well-pleasing in his sight.
asv.11:1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
asv.11:2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the living things which ye may eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
asv.11:3: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that may ye eat.
asv.11:4: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that part the hoof: the camel, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
asv.11:5: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
asv.11:6: And the hare, because she cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, she is unclean unto you.
asv.11:7: And the swine, because he parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you.
asv.11:8: Of their flesh ye shall not eat, and their carcasses ye shall not touch; they are unclean unto you.
asv.11:9: These may ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that may ye eat.
asv.11:10: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination unto you,
asv.11:11: and they shall be an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, and their carcasses ye shall have in abomination.
asv.11:12: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that is an abomination unto you.
asv.11:13: And these ye shall have in abomination among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the gier-eagle, and the ospray,
asv.11:14: and the kite, and the falcon after its kind,
asv.11:16: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the sea-mew, and the hawk after its kind,
asv.11:17: and the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
asv.11:18: and the horned owl, and the pelican, and the vulture,
asv.11:19: and the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
asv.11:20: All winged creeping things that go upon all fours are an abomination unto you.
asv.11:21: Yet these may ye eat of all winged creeping things that go upon all fours, which have legs above their feet, wherewith to leap upon the earth;
asv.11:22: even these of them ye may eat: the locust after its kind, and the bald locust after its kind, and the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.
asv.11:23: But all winged creeping things, which have four feet, are an abomination unto you.
asv.11:24: And by these ye shall become unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcass of them shall be unclean until the even;
asv.11:25: and whosoever beareth aught of the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
asv.11:26: Every beast which parteth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, is unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
asv.11:27: And whatsoever goeth upon its paws, among all beasts that go on all fours, they are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcass shall be unclean until the even.
asv.11:28: And he that beareth the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
asv.11:29: And these are they which are unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth: the weasel, and the mouse, and the great lizard after its kind,
asv.11:30: and the gecko, and the land-crocodile, and the lizard, and the sand-lizard, and the chameleon.
asv.11:31: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.
asv.11:32: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherewith any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.
asv.11:33: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean, and it ye shall break.
asv.11:34: All food therein which may be eaten, that on which water cometh, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
asv.11:35: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcass falleth shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
asv.11:36: Nevertheless a fountain or a pit wherein is a gathering of water shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcass shall be unclean.
asv.11:37: And if aught of their carcass fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
asv.11:38: But if water be put upon the seed, and aught of their carcass fall thereon, it is unclean unto you.
asv.11:39: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcass thereof shall be unclean until the even.
asv.11:40: And he that eateth of the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
asv.11:41: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth is an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
asv.11:42: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all fours, or whatsoever hath many feet, even all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
asv.11:43: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
asv.11:44: For I am Jehovah your God: sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that moveth upon the earth.
asv.11:45: For I am Jehovah that brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
asv.11:46: This is the law of the beast, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth;
asv.11:47: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.
asv.12:1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
asv.12:2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a man-child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the impurity of her sickness shall she be unclean.
asv.12:3: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
asv.12:4: And she shall continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
asv.12:5: But if she bear a maid-child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her impurity; and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
asv.12:6: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb a year old for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtle-dove, for a sin-offering, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest:
asv.12:7: and he shall offer it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. This is the law for her that beareth, whether a male or a female.
asv.12:8: And if her means suffice not for a lamb, then she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons; the one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
asv.13:1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
asv.13:2: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
asv.13:3: and the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and if the hair in the plague be turned white, and the appearance of the plague be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
asv.13:4: And if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
asv.13:5: and the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if in his eyes the plague be at a stay, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
asv.13:6: and the priest shall look on him again the seventh day; and, behold, if the plague be dim, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
asv.13:7: But if the scab spread abroad in the skin, after that he hath showed himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again:
asv.13:8: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the scab be spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.
asv.13:9: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
asv.13:10: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if there be a white rising in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising,
asv.13:11: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: he shall not shut him up; for he is unclean.
asv.13:12: And if the leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his feet, as far as appeareth to the priest;
asv.13:13: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
asv.13:14: But whensoever raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
asv.13:15: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean: it is leprosy.
asv.13:16: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, then he shall come unto the priest;
asv.13:17: and the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the plague be turned into white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
asv.13:18: And when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a boil, and it is healed,
asv.13:19: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be showed to the priest;
asv.13:20: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy, it hath broken out in the boil.
asv.13:21: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and it be not lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
asv.13:22: and if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
asv.13:23: But if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
asv.13:24: Or when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a burning by fire, and the quick flesh of the burning become a bright spot, reddish-white, or white;
asv.13:25: then the priest shall look upon it; and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin; it is leprosy, it hath broken out in the burning: and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
asv.13:26: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
asv.13:27: and the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
asv.13:28: And if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread in the skin, but be dim; it is the rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is the scar of the burning.
asv.13:29: And when a man or woman hath a plague upon the head or upon the beard,
asv.13:30: then the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, and there be in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a scall, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
asv.13:31: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and there be no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
asv.13:32: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the scall be not spread, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the appearance of the scall be not deeper than the skin,
asv.13:33: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
asv.13:34: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall; and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
asv.13:35: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,
asv.13:36: then the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
asv.13:37: But if in his eyes the scall be at a stay, and black hair be grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
asv.13:38: And when a man or a woman hath in the skin of the flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
asv.13:39: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin; he is clean.
asv.13:40: And if a man’s hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
asv.13:41: And if his hair be fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead bald; yet is he clean.
asv.13:42: But if there be in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague; it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
asv.13:43: Then the priest shall look upon him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague be reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh;
asv.13:44: he is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his plague is in his head.
asv.13:45: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and the hair of his head shall go loose, and he shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
asv.13:46: All the days wherein the plague is in him he shall be unclean; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his dwelling be.
asv.13:47: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
asv.13:48: whether it be in warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in anything made of skin;
asv.13:49: if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be showed unto the priest.
asv.13:50: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up that which hath the plague seven days:
asv.13:51: and he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever service skin is used for; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
asv.13:52: And he shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in woollen or in linen, or anything of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
asv.13:53: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;
asv.13:54: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
asv.13:55: and the priest shall look, after that the plague is washed; and, behold, if the plague have not changed its color, and the plague be not spread, it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire: it is a fret, whether the bareness be within or without.
asv.13:56: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be dim after the washing thereof, then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
asv.13:57: and if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is breaking out: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
asv.13:58: And the garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
